glosses.text: 修改，修订；修订本，订正版；复习，温习

collins: To make a revision of something that is written or something that has been decided means to make changes to it in order to improve it, make it more modern, or make it more suitable for a particular purpose. 修改; 修正

examples.en: Have you started your revision yet?
The phase of writing that is actually most important is revision.
examples.zh: 写作中真正最重要的阶段是修改。
